text:
The short-haired, plump white employee provided terrible service and had an unpleasant attitude.

We had an appointment at the clinic for 6 PM, but arrived 20 minutes late (my fault, not anyone's). When I walked in, the employee turned to a colleague and said, "There's a customer," then laughed.

She then curtly told me, "The doctor has already left," showing no empathy for me, who had driven all the way there for dental treatment but received no service.

The clinic called me at 5:40 PM, but I was in a meeting and missed it. When I called back, it was a central number. I'm certain I didn't receive proper communication from the clinic, as I confirmed my appointment the day before, and the clinic closes at 8 PM.

- Communication: 0
- Customer Service: -10

I regret not being able to see the doctor because the reviews all said the doctor was lovely and provided good service. Some reviews even mentioned unpleasant receptionists, but I never expected to experience it myself. Honestly, I'm very disappointed because I genuinely wanted to be a satisfied customer, but I was treated like I was a joke.
